article.title: Vote "No!" to Banning Ice Cream
article.author: Cherry Garcia
article.featured_img_alt: A community announcement displayed outside the ice cream shop
article.content:
A playful proposal to ban ice cream before dinner has made its way onto the agenda for this month's neighborhood meeting.

Scoops and Smiles believes dessert decisions belong to the people. We invite our neighbors to attend the meeting, share their sweetest memories, and stand up for the occasional pre-dinner cone.

The community meeting begins at 6 p.m. Thursday at Town Hall. Complimentary mini scoops will be served afterward.
